findings.affected: 101 / 276 rows: 56 OLBG-only URLs, 11 Darts rows on an unrendered PDC page, 33 Greyhound rows linked to completed results only, and 1 MotoGP event linked to the general calendar.
findings.detail: The upstream desk marks these rows listing_only=true and unpriced. Fifty-six rows use an OLBG category URL as official_url; another 45 use official-domain URLs but the captured page does not verify the specific event/contestants (11 PDC schedule bytes unavailable, 33 GBGB rows linked to completed results, and 1 MotoGP general-calendar event with no head-to-head riders). Retain them only as unverified listings, leave unsupported match/date/runner values blank, and do not count the links as fixture verification.
findings.manual_note: Official links above are review destinations; they do not confirm the listing-only rows.

findings.title: 101 rows are explicitly listing-only, not fixture-confirmed

findings.affected: 87 of 159 priced rows select a handicap, total, run line, puck line or total-games market as pick_market; 72 select Money Line / Match Winner.
findings.detail: The desk stores a match_winner market on priced rows, but has no dedicated winner_pick field. Where the highlighted pick is a different market, choosing the highest-probability match-winner side would require a derivation not published as an explicit selection. The user requirement is not met by a handicap or total pick alone.
findings.manual_note: Market outcome probabilities are present; a separate match-winner selection is not.
findings.title: 87 priced rows do not publish a standalone match-winner pick

findings.affected: All 954 selection outcomes have book_decimal/book_american identical to fair_decimal/fair_american; 10 of 10 High rows have no OLBG/bookmaker quote attached.
findings.detail: The Board AH methodology says bookmaker prices are not shown, and the high-pick band is applied to internally originated fair American odds. This is transparent as a fair-line rule, but it does not verify that a match's market price sits in the requested −250…+10,000 window. Do not label these as market odds.
findings.manual_note: No bookmaker/OLBG price is verified for the highlighted fair-line selections.

Greyhound rows have no runner identities and cite a results page, not a future card. Keep them separately classified or blank/flag them rather than treating them as confirmed matchups.

findings.affected: Current data/master.json has 354 rows, 39 without source_url (31 in the requested scope, 8 out of scope), 162 before 23 October, and 9 out-of-scope rows. Its generated_on is 2026-10-21.
findings.detail: The file's own cutoff_note says values were copied from older builds and nothing was refreshed. Board AI's repository audit records 336 rows versus 354 currently committed (18 row denominator difference). Its R2/R3 totals re-derive, but its R1 count uses inconsistent in_scope flags; the flag mismatch is detailed in AK-F13. Re-run the review after a master refresh; do not use this as today's 15-sport fixture list.
findings.manual_note: This is a repository-content finding; no external official source applies. Missing-source rows remain unlinked and flagged.
findings.title: The root canonical master is a 21 October mixed-sport snapshot

findings.affected: Board AK's later desk was generated at 2026-10-23T19:51:14Z; README.md links it, but root index.html does not.
findings.detail: This report audits the earlier Board AH/AI snapshots only; it does not assess or certify the newer Board AK 63ad3394 desk. The root landing page still foregrounds Board AI/AP and older boards, while the README has a direct link to the later desk. This report exposes that desk separately but does not edit shared navigation under the coordination boundary.
findings.manual_note: Repository navigation finding; no external official source applies. The later desk is linked for discovery but is outside this audit's reviewed dataset.
findings.title: The root landing omits the newer 23 October Board AK desk

findings.affected: The desk's round2 folder is labeled 20261023T170000Z but its manifest records 16:23:04Z; a third capture folder 20261023T173000Z records 16:26:38Z and is not listed in desk.captures.
findings.detail: The desk was generated at 16:35:59Z, after the manifest times, so this is not proof of impossible chronology. It is a provenance ambiguity: directory stamps differ from captured_at_utc, and one committed capture is not named by the desk. Use manifest timestamps and confirm which payloads were actually consumed before describing the desk as refreshed.
findings.manual_note: This is a timestamp-label inconsistency, not proof that the official fixture data is wrong.
findings.title: Board AI capture-folder stamps and desk references are inconsistent

findings.affected: The 10 High rows have unique 47–65-word texts and explicit selections, but their linked inputs are principally season records/rates; the capture set contains no player injury-report feed.
findings.detail: The text-length, uniqueness and selection checks pass. However, the published High write-ups do not consistently cite a recent match result or named player/line-up evidence, and no official injury source was captured for these rows. Do not imply that injuries were checked or that a player is available; refresh from team/tour reports before expanding these predictions.
findings.manual_note: No injury claims were made by this audit; the missing injury feed is an information gap, not evidence that there are no injuries.
findings.title: High-pick texts rely on season aggregates; recent results and injury checks are not consistently evidenced

findings.affected: 14 rows disagree: 9 out-of-scope rows are marked in-scope, while 5 Gaelic Football rows (the repo's Gaelic Sports alias) are marked out-of-scope. The file declares 349 in-scope rows; the sport-label recheck yields 345.
findings.detail: The Board AI review's R1 count of 39 is based on the inconsistent in_scope boolean. Rechecking by sport labels finds 31 source-less rows in the requested scope and 8 source-less rows outside it; therefore 8 unverified out-of-scope rows are counted as in-scope defects. Normalize Gaelic Football/Gaelic Sports and filter the out-of-scope labels before relying on master-level counts.
findings.manual_note: This is a classification-field defect in the repository; unconfirmed source cells remain blank and flagged.
findings.title: Canonical master in_scope flags conflict with the 15-sport taxonomy on 14 rows

method.fair_odds: American fair odds are recomputed from the stored fair probability after the desk's 3-decimal decimal-odds rounding. A field named book_* is not treated as a market quote when it exactly duplicates fair_*.
method.freshness: Folder names are retained as labels, but manifest timestamps take precedence. Desk cutoffs, capture timestamps and audit as-of are reported separately.
method.not_live: The audit is not a live feed and does not assert that a scheduled event has completed or that an unconfirmed fixture exists.
method.officiality: Official-domain links are not by themselves proof that a captured page contains a particular fixture. Rows marked listing_only remain unconfirmed even where the URL host belongs to a governing body.

master.cutoff_note: Every value is copied from the committed data of builds A, B, C, D, E and G. Nothing is inferred or refreshed; each row carries the source URL its build recorded.

source_policy: This is a static audit of committed captures and desk files. SHA-256 manifests, source URL references, market arithmetic and dashboard metadata were checked locally. No live HTTP re-fetch was performed by this audit; official links are supplied for manual review and are not presented as fresh confirmations.
